title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If you want to have a cigar later, let me know

Appreciate the offer. You and Al take Cigar smoking to the true connoisseur level by finding a rooftop bar that offers a smoking area. I usually stand out front here at the hotel and smoke until I either finish my Cigar, or am approached by the twelfth Meth addict; whichever one comes first. I’m waking up at 5:30 AM to go hack up a golf course with Schmakel, so I will turn in early tonight. BTW, Nice article on Andy. I figured Eddie would be a good source for you. Enjoy your smoke. I’ll see you tomorrow at the park.
Ok, see you tomorrow. And thank you, appreciate you pointing me in that direction
